scenes.text: Forbes says Elon Musk is worth eight hundred sixty-nine billion dollars. Let's spend it.
First, every copy of GTA 6 sold on day one. Three point seven nine billion.
Then all of America's online shopping on Cyber Week. Forty-four billion.
Thanksgiving dinner for every single American? Only two billion.
Still eight hundred and nineteen billion left.
Okay. Let's pay off the US debt with everything that's left...

title: I Tried to Spend Elon Musk's $869 Billion
